title: Nicholas Zakas: Scalable JavaScript Application Architecture
summary: Nicholas Zakas of Yahoo discusses architecture for large, modular JavaScript web applications. He lays out the theory behind building front ends that scale in complexity.
why: Recommended as a framework-agnostic, common-sense guide to structuring large front-end applications.

quote.text: It's framework-agnostic and not heavy on code, just a lot of common sense that might not be obvious for some.
